explanation: This method exhibits a SQL injection (CWE-89) anti-pattern by using percent-formatting (%d) to embed postid directly into sqlText. While %d enforces numeric formatting at runtime if postid is an integer, unsafe string construction risks SQL manipulation if types change or validation is bypassed. The repair switches to a %s placeholder and passes params=[postid] separately to sql.queryDB, though proper parameter binding depends on the unseen sql.queryDB implementation.
